reviewed_protocol.decision: Accepted exactly as frozen. This review elaborates test/readback detail without expanding its scientific or execution authority. If the predicted omission is falsified by actual tests, retain that result and make no forced correction.

review_type: independent preimplementation protocol review; not author/source/runtime acceptance
summary: Accept root's bounded saved-claims projection-fidelity protocol. Add the complete supplied claims object to visible SVG, SVG metadata, renderer stdout and persistHeadingTrace receipt. Preserve unavailable legacy claims explicitly as null/unavailable; never invent UNKNOWN values or claim missing qualifications were retained. No new reporter, producer, geometry or scientific evaluation is needed.
native_status: Root acknowledged epoch1 recommendation and successful native start before this final review artifact. Parent owns native finish.
source_findings: renderTrace currently selects prediction for its visible header and source/input/identity bindings for metadata, but selects no claims. main stdout likewise selects no claims. Existing checkTrace is structural, not scientific evaluation.

persistHeadingTrace writes the full trace and then constructs a narrower receipt containing prediction/renderRows/identities but no claims. Its direct exported function writes files only; it never calls the producer. runHeadingCLI is the separate execution entry and remains prohibited in this packet.

Importing cli.mjs imports recipe definitions and a pure fixed-plan/hash construction; source inspection finds no input/file/store/CV execution until runHeadingAblation is called. Tests must never call runHeadingCLI or runHeadingAblation.

The exact saved nonpixel E4009 trace has SUPPORTED, Dprimary 0.511630963318769, Dbright -1.266855366519426, four rows and sixty-four stations. Its complete claims include promoted=false, four explicit UNKNOWN physical/confidence fields, and conditional in-sample sampling evidence; rotation changes support. These coexist consistently with SUPPORTED.

accepted_contract.inputs: Trusted parsed saved heading-ablation trace, existing schema/row/station guards and exact input hash at the existing renderer CLI boundary. No generic untrusted-object/serializer/schema-hardening expansion.
accepted_contract.claims_copy: Copy the whole supplied claims object/value without a six-key whitelist, renaming, inferred defaults, evaluation or dropped extension fields. Keep nested/extra supplied fields in machine-readable output and visible serialized claims text. Preserve false/null/UNKNOWN exactly; no promotion is inferred from prediction status.
accepted_contract.legacy_missing: For a trace without claims, emit an explicit claims:null machine value and visible unavailable/null label. Explicit null is also unavailable, not an authoritative UNKNOWN tuple. A partially supplied claims object remains only that supplied object; do not fill absent fields. Existing projection-only receipt schema must remain rejected as a renderer trace.
accepted_contract.outputs: Existing renderTrace visible header and SVG metadata; existing main stdout summary; existing persistHeadingTrace returned/written receipt and therefore its existing stdout route. No need to invoke producer CLI or add another entry point to test this.
accepted_contract.invariants: Retained prediction and all D/group/station values, renderRows, rowIDs, stationIDs, ordering, source/input bindings and original sealed E4009/E4013 files stay unchanged. Existing metadata schema and receipt schema may gain additive claims only; do not rebind old trace execution source hashes to new renderer source.
accepted_contract.layout: Reuse current XML escaping, line wrapping and dynamic header height. Claims must be visible, not only hidden metadata; added header lines must not overlap or clip existing panels. Escape all added human text and metadata JSON through the existing XML-safe path.
accepted_contract.limits: Preserve exclusive fresh-output writes, input hash checks and existing per-file/total caps. No cap relaxation, overwrite, conversion of output failures to success or retry-to-green.

admitted_test_design_not_execution.base: Read exact E4009 trace bytes at the pinned hash; call actual renderTrace, main and persistHeadingTrace exports as relevant, never copied consumer implementations, stubs replacing their logic or source-text substring tests.
admitted_test_design_not_execution.red: Before product edits, run the narrowly frozen fidelity tests against existing source and retain an actual assertion failure caused by missing saved claims in the real outputs. Syntax/import/missing-module failures do not establish the intended RED. Stop on an unrelated failure for diagnosis.
admitted_test_design_not_execution.positive: Assert deep equality of copied claims in parsed SVG metadata, renderer stdout and returned/written CLI receipt, and exact saved qualifier content in visible SVG. Assert unchanged prediction/renderRows, four row IDs and all sixty-four station identities/blocks. persistHeadingTrace receives an exclusive fresh directory created by the test; it does not create that directory itself.
admitted_test_design_not_execution.negative_and_extensions: Derive clearly labeled test-only clones of the exact trace for missing claims and XML-special-character/extra-field cases. Missing legacy claims must yield explicit unavailable/null, never synthesized physical authority. Extra/nested qualifiers and characters such as <, &, quotation marks must survive machine readback exactly and be safely escaped in visible SVG/metadata. These are consumer fixtures, not new observations or scientific evidence.
admitted_test_design_not_execution.green_and_review: After separately admitted implementation and written-flow checkpoint, rerun the same focused tests without changing assertions to obtain GREEN. Independent review should inspect actual retained output and source delta, not count duplicate producer/geometry work as evidence. Any real standalone display/render command or rasterization remains separately admitted.

differences_from_scout_proposal: Root's explicit legacy-null policy supersedes S6's optional complete-claims-only rejection proposal. Do not reject a structurally valid legacy trace solely because claims are absent, and do not manufacture defaults.
Modify existing renderer/CLI projection sites only; no additive reporter, broad validation framework or recipe change is required.
